longshot.hypothesis: Favorite-longshot bias: cheap contracts are overpriced, so true probabilities are more extreme than prices.
longshot.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks

memory.hypothesis: Series memory: a series' own past gap between outcome and price persists, so shifting the price by that gap (shrunk when history is short) beats the price.
memory.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks

nn.hypothesis: A small neural network trained on settled markets (price, spread, time of day, category, series memory) can correct the market price. Starts equal to the market; judged only on data it never trained on.

development.what: walk-forward on past markets (development evidence, not the verdict)

nn.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks
nn.kind: neural network [26,8,4,1], residual on the market, gated
nn.limits: returns the market price while its walk-forward test says 'worse'

crypto_fair.hypothesis: Outside data: a coin's Coinbase spot price and recent volatility (random-walk model) price Kalshi crypto strikes better than the market.

development.what: walk-forward on past markets (development evidence, not the verdict)

crypto_fair.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks
crypto_fair.kind: random-walk fair value from Coinbase spot and 1-minute volatility
crypto_fair.limits: approximates Kalshi's CF Benchmarks settlement index

weather_nws.hypothesis: Outside data: the latest NWS station observation plus the forecast's change to the target hour prices Kalshi hourly temperature markets better than the market.
weather_nws.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks

ensemble.hypothesis: A logistic blend of the active models (calib, nn, crypto_fair) and the market, trained only on their out-of-sample estimates, beats the price. Capped at ±10 points from the market.

development.what: walk-forward on past markets (development evidence, not the verdict)

ensemble.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks

calib.hypothesis: A logistic correction of the market price (price, time left, spread, microprice, book imbalance, trade flow, volatility, outside data, series history, category) refit on every settlement beats the price. Capped at ±10 points from the market.

development.what: walk-forward on past markets (development evidence, not the verdict)

calib.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks
calib.kind: logistic market correction (Newton, L2 toward the market)

ladder.hypothesis: Structure: across the strikes of one event, probabilities must be monotone (and a full set of ranges must sum to 1). A strike quoted off that curve moves back onto it.
ladder.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks

weather_idx.hypothesis: Outside data: the average of the settlement index's own member airport stations (NWS observations), with the last hour's trend carried forward, prices hourly temperature markets. σ never below 2.5°F, estimates clamped to 3–97%. Scored on its own; no paper portfolio until it passes.
weather_idx.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks

llm.hypothesis: A language model that reads the rules, dated news facts and how similar past markets resolved (retrieved from memory, only items dated before the estimate) can correct the price. Local model by default; capped at ±15 points from the market. Only runs where a local model is available.
llm.wouldChange: the peeking-safe sequence excluding 0 on ≥ 100 live markets, plus profitable picks
